info.name: FluxPay M5 - CURRENT prototype smoke tests (not revised-spec acceptance)
info.description: Generated 2026-09-11 from current Java. Review docs/M5-CODE-REVIEW-AND-TESTING.md first. This collection performs INSERT/UPDATE via local development APIs when YOU run it. No requests were executed during the review. Configure the backend against a dedicated test schema, check vector dimensions, and populate payment variables from m5-current-smoke-fixtures.sql. 0 automated Java tests exist. This is not the new specification's acceptance suite. No Auth reflects a known current security gap. Clear runId before a new full run to create a fresh policy; don't rerun only 'Create synthetic policy' with the same runId except to test a duplicate.

exec: if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1):\d+$/.test(base)) throw new Error("Use only the local development backend, e.g. http://localhost:8081.");
pm.test("Every returned case matches status", () => pm.expect(response.data.every(c => c.status === "OPEN")).to.eql(true));

pm.test("Every returned case matches status", () => pm.expect(response.data.every(c => c.status === "CLOSED")).to.eql(true));
